MRS. JUSTICE SUSMITA PHUKAN KHAUND  ORDER 10.11.2023 1

. Heard Mr. M.U. Mondal, learned counsel for the petitioners as well as Mr. B. Sharma, learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State respondent.
Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175672360/
1 2.

The petitioners, namely, Smti. Kamakhya Das and Smti Indu Das, have filed this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C with prayer for pre-arrest bail as they are apprehending arrest in connection with Dispur P.S. Case No. 1849/2023, under Sections 342/498A/506 IPC.
3.

The FIR unfolds that the victim was married to Sunny Das 25.11.2022 and from the threshold of her marriage she was subjected to cruelty by her mother- in-law and sister-in-law of the victim i.e.
the present petitioners.
4. I have considered the submissions at the Bar and I have also perused the case diary.
5. The learned Addl. P.P. has raised serious objections stating that the petitioner has admitted that he is complicit.
6. There are indeed incriminating materials in the case diary against the petitioner.
The petitioner has however co-operated with the investigation.
7. The investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
The petitioner is a local resident.
The petitioner has appeared before the I/O and his statement has been recorded and he has cooperated with the investigation.
He has not Page No.# 3/3 violated any bail conditions.
8. Considering all aspects, the interim bail order dated 12.10.2023 is hereby made absolute.
Send back the case diary.
